title: Nazim Belabbaci
text:
Welcome!
I’m a Research Engineer/Scientist focused on AI for Health. I design ML methods and systems to quantify hydration, fatigue, and autonomic state from wearables; build 1D diffusion models for spectroscopy; and develop reproducible clinical ML pipelines.

Wearables & digital biomarkers
